errors.text: The proposed alloy, AlCoCrFeNi2.1, does not match the composition-constrained Al0.7CoCrFeNi target.
The intervention adds severe plastic deformation and uses 10–20 GPa rather than reconstructing the direct hexahedron-anvil HPHT treatment at 6 GPa and 1473 K for 2 hours.
The proposed 600–900 °C temperature window excludes the target treatment temperature of approximately 1200 °C.
The HIP comparison is confounded because the extreme-pressure group also receives severe plastic deformation, so it cannot isolate pressure as the causal variable.
